spec_evidence.checked: Walked both cached specs: OLD paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/containers while NEW does not; NEW paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications carrying the method set (get). NEW introduces a containers/applications family (get, post plus per-application routes) absent from OLD; the bare collection listing is replaced by the applications listing.

alternative_data_source: the successor route /accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications in the NEW spec

fix.migration_guide: Mechanical URL rewrite at every call site: requests hitting '/accounts/{account_id}/containers' (get) move to '/accounts/{account_id}/containers/applications'. Update raw URL builders, route constants and API client wrappers accordingly. NEW introduces a containers/applications family (get, post plus per-application routes) absent from OLD; the bare collection listing is replaced by the applications listing.
